description_expanded:
📍 WaterColor

🏖️ Access to WaterColor Beach Club & Trolley

👙 Private pool! (optional heat)

🕶️ Community pools, seasonally heated

🛺 6-seater golf cart

🚲 6 bikes!

🛌 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths (Sleeps 14)

🍔 Covered outdoor patio with fireplace, TV, and grill

17 Bluestem Ln by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 17 Bluestem Ln is a two-story WaterColor retreat with soaring ceilings, stylish spaces, and plenty of room for everyone to settle in. Seaside’s shops and restaurants are just around the corner, while your own private pool is waiting out back. And with a six-seater golf cart and six bikes included, getting around 30A is half the fun. The main level centers around a gourmet kitchen with a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf range, and all the essentials for morning coffee, beach lunches, and dinner for the whole crew. A mini-bar makes evening drinks easy, while the eight-person dining table and four island seats give everyone a spot at the table. There’s also a full laundry room and half bath. Five bedrooms give everyone their own space.

The first floor has a primary suite with a king bed, and a guest room with two full beds, both with private bathrooms. Upstairs is another primary suite, and a guest room with a king bed, and a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks, a couch, TV, and private bathroom. The home sleeps 14 across five bedrooms and 5.5 baths. Out back, things get even better. Take a dip in the private pool, then relax with your crew under the covered patio with an outdoor fireplace, TV, and gas grill. The pool can also be heated seasonally for an additional fee. There’s an outdoor shower for sandy feet, too. The front porch swing is ready for slow mornings, while your golf cart and bikes are ready for shopping, dining, adventuring, and just about everything else. WaterColor’s community pools, private Beach Club, and neighborhood trolley are all included with your stay. The Beach Club is about 0.7 miles away. At Oversee 30A, we keep it simple: clean, comfortable stays with a local team close by. Our nearby office is open seven days a week, with 24/7 support whenever you need us. Overview: - .7 of a mile to beach (private WaterColor beach club) - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - 6-seater golf cart - 6 bikes included - Covered outdoor patio with fireplace, TV, and gas grill - Gourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero fridge, Wolf range, and mini-bar - Front porch with swing and comfortable patio furniture - Outdoor shower - Wi-Fi *Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands. Overnight: FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: king bed, private bathroom, TV - Guest Room: two Full beds, private bathroom, TV - Half bath SECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: king bed, private bathroom, TV - Guest Room: king bed, private bathroom, TV - Bunk Room: two twin-over-twin bunks, couch, private bathroom,TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
